verdict.rationale: Docs say users can search and filter traces by any span attribute, analyze logs in Table and Time Series views, break panels out by an attribute, and query with ClickHouse SQL. Together these imply ad-hoc filtering and grouping on arbitrary fields. None of the evidence explicitly addresses high-cardinality fields like user or request IDs, or confirms this works without pre-aggregation or index setup. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of group-by and filter on high-cardinality attributes with no index or pre-aggregation required, and independent hands-on corroboration of query behavior at high cardinality.
